# Rinkesh Gorasia

> Two-time founder based in Bengaluru, India. Built Savior (a healthcare-operations platform acquired by Zocdoc) and Career Leap (live soft-skills learning for tech professionals, which he shut down himself). Now looking for an early-stage product or founding (0 to 1) role, and building heavily with AI.

Rinkesh is a 0-to-1 product person who has built two companies from a rough problem to a real product. He goes deep on the problem, ships fast, and knows when to stop. He builds with Claude daily and treats AI as leverage on judgment, not a replacement for it.

## Experience

- **Savior** (2017-2020): Healthcare-operations software for tier-1 hospitals in India (Fortis, Cloudnine). Bootstrapped to 85 hospitals and profitability with no sales team — all word of mouth. Built a team of 85. Acquired by Zocdoc in 2020.
- **Career Leap** (2020-2023): Live soft-skills learning for tech professionals. Grew from a WhatsApp group to 10K users in six months, 100K+ watch hours, 40% completion on live cohorts (industry average 5-10%), about Rs 15L in revenue. He shut it down when the unit economics didn't hold at scale.

## Currently Building (with AI)

- **Sniff** (Live): Scan any cat food and see how good it actually is — no sponsored rankings. https://sniff.fyi
- **KnowYourPay** (Live): Find out if you're underpaid for your exact role and city. https://knowyourpay.in
- **Product Sense Lab** (Live): Practice PM interviews under pressure, with instant AI feedback. https://www.productsenselab.com
- **Vouch** (Just shipped): Save and share the places you actually love, in one link. https://vouchforit.club
